text:
alice: Heads up — after the 09:00 console rollout we're seeing a spike of 503s for a handful of orgs (notably acme-corp). Looks like quota enforcement is rejecting requests. Investigating now. :eyes:

sre-oncall: Seeing same. Traffic for acme-corp dropped ~70% and errors are 503 Service Unavailable with quota_exceeded in the logs.

deploy-bot: deploy:service/console v3.14.0 promoted to prod at 2026-03-18T09:01:12Z (canary=20%).

ben: Any config changes in the rollout? We shipped the new quota translation layer that converts console "burst_units" to internal bucket config. Could be a unit mismatch.

alice: Paste from logs: ```
[2026-03-18T09:05:03Z] request_id=f4a2 quota=org:acme-corp limit=6000 burst=0 -> reject: quota_exceeded (converted_bucket: per-key)
[2026-03-18T09:05:03Z] resp 503 content="Quota enforcement error"
```

infra: That log line suggests the burst field is being interpreted as per-key instead of per-org. The translation change maps burst_units -> bucket_scope but looks like defaulting to SK (single-key) for org-level configs when the org flag is present.

carol: Is the console sending the right scope? UX didn't change here, we only changed internal mapping. If the mapping flipped scope, org burst budgets are effectively being split across API keys. That explains acme's big drop — they have many keys.

product-ops: Confirmed: acme-corp has 18 API keys. Under per-key enforcement their effective total throughput would be 1/18th of expected.

ben: Oof. That conversion function was added in PR #4572. I can hotfix to revert translation to previous behavior or roll back the service. Which is faster?

alice: Rolling back the console will take ~20–30m due to canary rampdown and cache invalidation. A hotfix to the translation layer (force scope=org if org_id present) can be patched and rolled within ~10m.

infra: I can push a hotfix to the quota-adapter service now. Patch will set: `if org_id != null -> scope = "org"` (previously we let console set scope).

ben: +1 for hotfix. Also add a temporary bypass rule for acme-corp to avoid churn while fix propagates: set override quota to their previous numeric values in enforcement store.

infra: Applying override now for org:acme-corp -> {limit: 6000, burst: 1200}... applied.

sre-oncall: After override, error rate for acme-corp dropped to baseline within 45s. Monitoring cluster-wide for regressions. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy:service/quota-adapter v2.9.1-hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-03-18T09:12:47Z (canary=100%).

alice: Post-deploy logs: ```
[2026-03-18T09:13:05Z] request_id=bc9d quota=org:acme-corp limit=6000 burst=1200 -> allow
[2026-03-18T09:13:06Z] resp 200 content="ok"
```

carol: Thanks team. We need a short postmortem and a UI test to ensure console->adapter mapping is explicit. Also add a QA case for multi-key orgs.

product-ops: Logging the incident and tagging acme-corp for customer outreach. Drafting a message with the timeline.

ben: I'll open a follow-up PR to add a stricter contract test between console and quota-adapter (schema validation + CI gate).

infra: Leaving increased alert sensitivity for quota-exceeded -> 15m window and paging if >3 orgs affected.

alice: Closing thread here — rollback avoided, hotfix worked. We'll collect more telemetry and prepare postmortem. :white_check_mark:
